players.product: NULISA precision-proteomics assays and ARGO HT System

quarterly_data.signal: CEO highlighted a study by Dr. Carlos Cruchaga at Washington University, published in the Journal of the Alzheimer's Association, that used the Alamar platform to develop an AI-based classifier capable of diagnosing neurodegenerative diseases and categorizing co-pathology from a blood sample; per the CEO, a carefully selected panel of just 15 proteins delivers strong diagnostic and co-pathology classification compared to hundreds of markers on a legacy platform. CEO: a scalable noninvasive method to categorize co-pathology has the potential to make clinical trials more productive. CEO also said eMTBR-tau data from multiple customer labs has already been submitted for publication.
